name: visualize
description: Generate, explore, and refine beautiful on-brand HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards.

interface.longDescription: visualize lets agents generate self-contained HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards — that read as your brand. Apply reference design systems as artifact themes, or compare structure and visual treatments before choosing. Project styling remains the default unless explicitly overridden for the artifact. System Explore compares new or replacement project systems before confirmed adoption. Brand capture and focused refine verbs work across 35 templates and 103 reference design systems. See https://display.dev/docs/visualize for the full feature set.
